**The securities-lending figure:** Table 1A shows "Securities lent to dealers" (overnight facility, fully collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities) at **$42,679 million** (weekly average; $39,780 million on the Wednesday, July 29, 2026 figure).

**Share:**
42,679 / 6,452,859 ≈ **0.66%** of the total U.S. Treasury, agency debt, and mortgage-backed securities reported in that memo item.
